name: Agent Assistant
description: A shared RHS conversation interface for chatting with an existing agent bot through Mattermost.

settings_schema.header: Connect Agent Assistant to an existing Mattermost bot and shared conversation channel. These settings are installation-specific and must be supplied by a Mattermost administrator.
settings_schema.footer: The plugin contains no bot or provider credentials. The configured bot must already be connected to its agent service and have access to the configured channel.

settings.help_text: Required. URL-safe team name from the Mattermost URL, for example: your-team-name.
Required. URL-safe channel name used to store shared Agent conversations. The bot and intended users must be channel members.
Required. Username of an existing Mattermost bot connected to the agent service. Do not enter an access token here.
